name: H3 Image Edit
summary: Edit a photo with P-H3-Image: up to 9 pictures, native size by default, optional 4/8 MP resize, fixed 8-step edit, prompt upsampler.

source.notes: PrunaAI p-h3-image edit workflow on the MiniMax H3 FL2VA transformer: the 19.5 GB int8 FL2VA base, the p-h3-image LoRA, the p-h3-image text encoder, VAE and prompt upsampler. Picture 1 is the photo being edited; Pictures 2-9 are optional references (p-h3-image accepts nine pictures total). The source is scaled to the selected megapixel area and the conditioning follows its aspect ratio. Empty reference slots cut both edges and are pruned before submission. The prompt upsampler rewrites the request unless Expand is off. Sampling is the model's fixed 8-step ManualSigmas schedule; the Steps and Scheduler controls stay on screen for the shared layout but do not alter that schedule. Resolution is now optional and off by default: with Custom resolution off, the conditioning reads Picture 1's native size through a lazy switch; turning it on scales Picture 1 to the selected megapixel target. The prompt upsampler always receives its own 0.97 MP copies of the pictures, independent of that switch.

inputs.label: Picture 1
inputs.help: The photo to edit. It becomes <Picture 1> in the prompt. Add up to eight optional references below; P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. With Custom resolution off, the output follows this picture's native size.

inputs.label: Picture 2
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 2> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 3
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 3> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 4
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 4> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 5
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 5> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 6
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 6> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 7
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 7> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 8
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 8> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Picture 9
inputs.help: Optional. P-H3-Image accepts nine pictures in total. It becomes <Picture 9> in the prompt; use it for identity, prop, material or composition. Leave no gaps if you can.

inputs.label: Edit instruction
inputs.default: Replace the vintage yellow taxi in <Picture 1> with a pastel pink ice-cream truck with a scalloped awning and a glowing service window, sitting in the same side profile at the curb.
inputs.help: What to change. Refer to the source as <Picture 1> and references as <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, and so on. A short instruction is enough; the prompt upsampler expands it when enabled.

inputs.label: Expand the prompt
inputs.help: Use the p-h3-image prompt upsampler to rewrite the instruction into a detailed edit brief. It receives 0.97 MP copies of every picture. Turn it off to send the instruction verbatim.

inputs.label: Custom resolution
inputs.help: Off: keep Picture 1's native size, which is also the output size. On: scale Picture 1 to the megapixel target below. The prompt upsampler always gets 0.97 MP copies either way.

inputs.label: Resolution (MP)
inputs.help: Used only when Custom resolution is on. P-H3-Image edits are best at 4 or 8 MP; with the switch off, Picture 1 keeps its native size.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: P-H3-Image uses a fixed 8-step ManualSigmas schedule; this control is kept for the shared layout and does not alter the render.

inputs.label: Sampler
inputs.help: The KSamplerSelect sampler used by the p-h3-image template. er_sde is its default.

inputs.label: Scheduler
inputs.help: P-H3-Image uses its own ManualSigmas schedule; this selector is kept for the shared layout and does not alter the render.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: -1 picks a random seed.

inputs.label: Diffusion model (DiT)

options.label: MiniMax H3 FL2VA int8 — p-h3 base

inputs.help: The MiniMax H3 FL2VA transformer that the p-h3-image LoRA turns into an editor.

inputs.label: Text encoder
inputs.help: The p-h3-image text encoder (type minimax).

inputs.label: Image VAE
inputs.help: The p-h3-image VAE. It also anchors the reference pictures as latents.

inputs.label: Prompt-expansion model
inputs.help: The prompt upsampler used by the p-h3-image edit template.

inputs.label: Filename prefix
inputs.help: Where ComfyUI writes the PNG under its output folder.
